_comment: An async function returns a thenable service (through Inspectable.toJson), so the host adopts it. Its then resolves with a nested thenable whose then stores a function on the reject function the host passes and calls it. Under the hand-written-thenable rule (adopting a non-native-Promise object with a callable then bails every service it can reach) the key bails, so every method stays, including the one nothing reads, and the bundle runs.
